title: Cybersecurity Certifications Guide

certifications.name: CompTIA Security+
prerequisites: Basic networking knowledge (Network+ recommended but not required)
certifications.industry_recognition: Gold standard baseline certification globally recognized and compliant with DoD 8140/8570 directive.
certifications.recommended_for: Students and career switchers aiming for Junior SOC Analyst and Information Security Officer roles.

certifications.name: CompTIA CySA+ (Cybersecurity Analyst)
prerequisites: CompTIA Security+ or minimum 2-3 years of hands-on security experience
certifications.industry_recognition: Validates behavioral analytics and hands-on defense monitoring for Tier 2 SOC analysts.
certifications.recommended_for: Practitioners seeking progression from Tier 1 triage to incident response.

certifications.name: Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
prerequisites: 2 years of work experience or attended official EC-Council training
certifications.industry_recognition: High HR keyword recognition in corporate recruiting.
certifications.recommended_for: Students interested in offensive security and understanding adversary techniques.
